subject: How to check if a shiny module is called in my app?

messages.author: 85e257c62437ca55
messages.subject: How to check if a shiny module is called in my app?
parts:
Hi everyone,

As a new comer to the shiny community, I have encountered a problem with shiny tab/module updates.

Basically, I am working on a app that calls a module on each tab of a tabsetPanel that runs variable simulations. The number of tabs is from user Input$Nvar, so the tabsetPanel is wrapped in a UI. What I am hoping is when Nvar is updated, instead of all the tabsetPanel gets refreshed as a whole, only necessary tabs are refreshed. For instance, when Nvar increases from 2 to 3, one new tab would be created while the older two tabs with module input settings remain the same.

I have tried using output$moduleTab1 or output$NS('moduleTab1', 'var')  to check if the module or namespaced module inputs exist, but shiny wouldn't allow to do it since they are called in the renderUI function.

Appreciated if some one can hint!
